To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we measured the masses of 80Y, 81Y, 82Y, 83Y, 83Zr, 84Zr, 85Zr, 86Zr, 88Zri and 85Nb, 86Nb, 87Nb, 88Nb with a typical precision better than 7keV.
we have measured the masses of neutron-deficient Zr and Nb isotopes with a high precision, which improved the knowledge of the nuclear masses and QEC values of these isotopes.
we have measured the masses of 80Y, 83Y and 84Zr for the first time and that we have improved the mass measurements of 80,81, 82Y, 82,83,84,85Zr and 83,84, 85Nb by 2-3 orders of magnitude.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of nuclear properties and nuclear reactions.
the study of nuclear properties of exotic nuclides.
the development of new methods for the study of nuclear structure and the application of these methods in the investigation of nuclear properties.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the mass of 82Zr has been confirmed, while that of 83Y is still not settled.
the present work has provided new mass data for neutron-deficient nuclei close to A =80.
the Penning-trap technique at IGISOL is a very efficient method for precise mass measurements of neutron deficient nuclides.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the new mass data for the nuclides in the A=80 region are consistent with the systematics of the mass surface.
the precision of our mass measurements have been improved from 10 to 7keV.
the mass measurements of the neutron deficient nuclides have been performed with a high precision and the results have been compared with the theoretical values.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the masses of 83, 85Zr and 84Nb are significantly higher than the previously accepted values, which have been revised by the atomic mass evaluation 2012.
our results show that the masses of 80Y and 81Zr are in good agreement with the AME2012 values.
the masses of 82, 84, and 85Y and 86, 89, and 91Zr have been measured with the highest precision.
